integrity: The rational generating function and centralizer count are supported by a full bijective proof and independent direct finite checks. Finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordered pairs of idempotents of total regressive monotone maps on finite labeled chains; no all-element commutation or other Hecke–Kiselman monoids are asserted. The univariate sequence is known OEIS A007070; this work concerns a refined Catalan-idempotent interpretation and centralizer counts. Bibliographic priority remains provisional.
title: Commuting-idempotent profiles and centralizers in finite Catalan monoids
